# [bug][ibex_decoder] Report a bug in Ibex
Hi all!
I am using a static analysis to found a various bugs in open source RTL designs.
It was founded that in `ibex_decoder.sv` RTL file dead code is exists [here](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/blob/master/rtl/ibex_decoder.sv#L439).
This assignment under `else` statement is never executed due to [this](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/blob/master/rtl/ibex_decoder.sv#L406) external `else` branch with `!instr[26]` condition.

Here is the project file that may be relevant to this issue:
